newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Argentaria sharply cut liabilities.
newsitem.headline: Spain Argentaria sharply cut liabilities.

text.p: Spanish bank Corporacion Bancaria de Espana (Argentaria) said on Friday that it had dedicated 50.6 percent of funds generated during the 1996 financial year to reduce the cost of liabilities.

A note said that as a result of that a 43.02 billion charge was made to the income statement following the cancellation of institutional liabilities bringing profits before tax for the group down to 42.03 billion instead of 85.05 billion which would have been reached had this strategic decision not be taken.
Argentaria originally announced the move in December, saying it would devote 42 billion pesetas of 1996 profits to cut costs.
Argentaria reported on Friday a 57.9 percent reduction in attributable profit to 31.22 billion pesetas, but its operating income rose 8.8 percent to 89.58 billion pesetas.
